items.title: DeepAgents
items.claim: DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph. It provides planning, sub-agents, a filesystem abstraction, and human-in-the-loop controls. For RefractRouter v0.1, DeepAgents is useful as the fixed-DAG execution harness, but its autonomous planning and dynamic sub-agent generation should remain disabled.

items.title: LangGraph
items.claim: LangGraph is a graph state machine framework for complex workflows. It supports explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing. RefractRouter uses LangGraph as the lower-level execution substrate for a fixed task DAG.

items.title: Pydantic AI
items.claim: Pydantic AI provides typed tool definitions and structured model outputs. It is useful when strict schemas are required, but RefractRouter v0.1 does not need it as a core dependency unless structured-output parsing becomes a bottleneck.
